messages:
maya: Dropping the company OKR draft for Q3–Q4 here. Need alignment by EOW. TL;DR: prioritize inference reliability, reduce cost-per-token, and get Private deployment pilot ready.

sam: Reading now. quick Q — can we tighten the unit-cost target? current draft says 25% reduction by EOY.

maya: The 25% is the ask from product leadership; it comes from batching + quantization + caching work. We can debate feasibility.

kai: Flag: key enterprise asks require an on-prem checklist + compliance artifacts before any pilot. Healthcare customer will insist.

diane: Proposed launch criteria (for marking an objective as "launch-ready"):
- Performance: p95 latency < 200ms for hosted small/latency-optimized models under realistic load patterns
- Cost: measurable 25% token cost reduction vs current baseline via batching/quantization recommendations
- Reliability: cross-region fallback + automatic model-variant fallback in place
- Customer readiness: 2 committed pilots (one fintech, one healthcare) with NDA/PO signed

frank: small nit — 200ms p95 feels loose for our customer SLAs. suggest p95 < 150ms for the small model profile.

maya: frank — can you run the perf sim tonight? quick command we use: 
```
wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s http://perf-test-host/generate
```

kai: Noted re: compliance. I'll loop in legal + security to draft the checklist and what evidence we need.

elena: Exec Q — how are we defining the "batched cost reduction" metric? we should avoid vague statements.

sam: Proposed metric: normalized $/token where baseline = unbatched single-request execution on the same model + tokens/second per GPU, averaged over representative workload. Include variance and sample prompts.

maya: +1 to that. also add a "no-regression" eval set (100 golden prompts) to gate model changes.

diane: If we hit those, Dedicated GA could be targeted for Nov. But we need to staff SRE rotations and finalize autoscaling policy.

frank: Vote: +1 if perf sim shows p95 <= 150ms and we secure 2 signed pilots.

kai: +1 conditional on legal signoffs for the healthcare pilot.

elena: Execs are +1 pending final perf numbers and pilot confirmations. This is the product-level signoff condition.

maya: Action items (pulling thread together):
- frank: run perf sim & post results here by 18:00 PT today (2234590000)
- kai: draft legal & security checklist by Wed EOD (2234810000)
- sam: write cost-definition + baseline doc by Tue (2234700000)
- diane: outreach to two pilot customers; confirm commitments and rough timelines
- maya: update OKR doc with explicit launch criteria and prep exec review for Thu

ops-bot: deploy scheduled — perf cluster runs at 19:00 PT; results will be auto-posted to this thread.

maya: Thanks — if frank's perf + two pilots are green we can mark the objective "Enterprise Private GA" as signoff-ready and move to roadmap finalization. :thumbsup:
